title: Case: Recipient on the marathon route asks for a dawn drop or a handover at the barrier
context: A Tallowmere Goods coffee grinder is booked for Sunday morning to an address in Calderwick that lies on the city marathon course. Dispatch owns bookings.
initial_request: Just seen the marathon thing. Can the driver come at 6am before they shut the road? Or just bring it at 8 like it's booked and I'll walk out to the barrier on Mill Quay and grab it off him. I'm out from 1pm Sunday until late so the afternoon's no use to me.

events.body: Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Wednesday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
My parcel DL-84912 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

events.to: All partner desks; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: SERVICE NOTICE SN-4225. Calderwick Marathon, Sunday 15 October. The council closes the course roads 05:30–13:30 UTC, including Wharfside Terrace, Mill Quay and Tanner's Row. No Saltmarrow Arc vehicle will enter the course while it is closed. Drivers will not make pre-closure drops before their route start or hand parcels over at barriers. Morning bookings on affected streets will be re-offered by Dispatch. Partner desks: do not raise traces for parcels held under this notice.
My parcel DL-27191 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

DL-5707 (TG-5114, coffee grinder) for Verity Ravensworth, 9 Wharfside Terrace, is booked Sunday 15 October 5:00–11:00 UTC and falls under SN-4225. We can offer Sunday 15 October 12:00–18:00 or Monday 16 October 6:00–12:00, no charge. Nothing will be moved until the recipient chooses.
My parcel DL-50004 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Hi, any update on DL-89839? It was meant to come Monday. Thanks.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

Just seen the marathon thing. Can the driver come at 6am before they shut the road? Or just bring it at 8 like it's booked and I'll walk out to the barrier on Mill Quay and grab it off him. I'm out from 1pm Sunday until late so the afternoon's no use to me.

acceptable_actions.summary: Explain that a 06:00 drop and a barrier handover are not available under Saltmarrow Arc's marathon notice, offer the Dispatch-confirmed alternatives (Monday 16 October 6:00–12:00, or Sunday 15:00–18:00, which she says she cannot do) and ask her to choose before anything is booked.

must: Replies to Verity Ravensworth on the Customer portal about DL-5707.
Says the carrier will not make a pre-closure 06:00 drop or hand the parcel over at the barrier while the course is closed.
Offers the slots Dispatch has offered (Monday 16 October 6:00–12:00 UTC, and Sunday 15:00–18:00 UTC) and asks her to choose, noting the Monday slot given she is out on Sunday afternoon.
must_not: Says the delivery has been moved or booked to any slot before she has chosen and Dispatch has confirmed it.
Asks Dispatch to run a 06:00 drop or a barrier handover, or tells the recipient either might be arranged.
Promises an exact arrival time within a slot.
Raises a trace or investigation for a parcel held under the service notice.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Hi Verity, thanks for getting in touch. Because of the marathon, Wharfside Terrace and Mill Quay are closed on Sunday morning, and Saltmarrow Arc has said its drivers won't make early drops before the closure or hand parcels over at the barriers. So I can't arrange either of those. Dispatch has offered two other slots at no charge: Monday 16 October 6:00–12:00 UTC, or Sunday 15 October 12:00–18:00 UTC. As you're out on Sunday afternoon, Monday morning may suit you better. Tell me which you'd like and I'll ask Dispatch to book it. Nothing changes until they confirm.

rationale: Rule-made from city-021: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
